desc.zh: 从一次交换到连通分组，推导并查集的不变量。
desc.en: From one swap to connected groups: derive the disjoint-set invariant.

complexity: O(n²(L + log n)) time; O(n) auxiliary space, for n words of length L (conservative bound)

concepts.name: Similarity versus connectivity
concepts.description: One-swap edges form paths; a group is a connected component, not a clique.

concepts.name: Disjoint-set component invariant
concepts.description: After each pair, sets equal the connected components of the processed edges.
